Problem Statement
Read a number and print a stack of pipes that grows row by row and then shrinks row by row. 
Description
In a warehouse, pipes are stacked in rows. The first row has 1 pipe, the second row has 2 pipes, and so on, up to a row with N pipes. After that, the rows become smaller by 1 pipe each time, until the last row has 1 pipe. Each pipe is shown by the * sign. Read N and print the stack. Do not print any spaces. 
Input Description
A single integer N, the number of pipes in the biggest row. (1 <= N <= 9) 
Output Description
Print the stack of pipes. Each row has only * signs and no spaces.

3
